name: Todd Horst
tagline: Engineering leader who still builds. A selection of things I've made.
bio: I'm an engineering leader and builder based in York, Pennsylvania. For 20 years I worked in healthcare technology at WellSpan Health, growing from integration analyst to leading a team of 11 and a platform of 2,800+ integration components. I've migrated 1,700+ live interfaces with no downtime, moved servers to AWS, and built the tools and standards that make teams faster. I've never stopped writing code: I founded and run two SaaS products, Tasty Tracker and LeaseTracker, and this site collects some of what I've built along the way.
